Allah wants to make things clear, guide to the practices of those before, accept repentance and lighten burdens, while followers of passions want deviation; mankind was created weak.
Instruction, healing for the breasts, guidance and mercy have come from the Lord; people should rejoice in Allah's bounty and mercy, which is better than what they accumulate.
Allah's servants are told that He is the Forgiving, the Merciful, and that His punishment is the painful punishment.
Allah tells His servants who sinned against themselves not to despair of His mercy, for He forgives all sins and is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
Allah accepts repentance, pardons misdeeds and answers believers; He sends provision in measure lest people commit tyranny, and sends rain after despair, spreading His mercy.
Believers who fear Allah and believe in His Messenger receive a double portion of mercy, a light and forgiveness, and the People of the Scripture learn all bounty is Allah's.
